skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] (when hit, adds Mountain-Bursting DMG equal to 140% ATK; the effect is removed after triggering).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] (when hit, adds Mountain-Bursting DMG equal to 160% ATK; the effect is removed after triggering).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. If any enemy is afflicted with [Internal Injury], self enters [Berserk] state (increases DMG dealt when attacking by 30%).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. If any enemy is afflicted with [Internal Injury], self enters [Berserk] state (increases DMG dealt when attacking by 40%).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by 20%. If any enemy is afflicted with [Internal Injury], self enters [Berserk] state (increases DMG dealt when attacking by 45%).

effects.desc: Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
